subject: Proof runway: onboarding cadence, roles & final readout plan
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finexahealth.com>; Priya Desai <priya.desai@finexahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 15:08:00 -0800
Subject: Proof runway: onboarding cadence, roles & final readout plan

Alex/Priya — thanks again for taking the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock the PoC timeline and owners. Please reply with any corrections.

Call recap (high level)
- Goal: Validate Redwood inference for Finexa claims-processing assistant (latency < 350ms p50 on 512-token requests; > 92% accuracy on slot extraction)
- Scope: 4-week evaluation against a seeded dataset + 1 week readout (5 calendar weeks total)
- Must-haves for decision: latency, extraction accuracy, cost per 1k requests, and integration effort estimate

Proposed PoC cadence and milestones (draft)
1) Week 0 (prep, target kickoff): Sandbox credentials + sample data exchange (this week)
2) Week 1 (ingest & baseline): Run seed dataset; baseline metrics w/ current model variant
3) Week 2 (optimization): Enable batching, KV prefix caching; iterate quantization profile for cost targets
4) Week 3 (integration): Call pattern stress test; end-to-end integration with Finexa staging
5) Week 4 (finalization): Readout prep, cost run, runbook for production handoff
6) Week 5 (readout): Exec results, acceptance decision, next steps (license/commit)

Ownership (suggested)
- Redwood: Sean (poC lead), Marissa (success/ops), Monica (SRE/debug & infra)
- Finexa: Alex (Product owner), Priya (Platform/integration)

Immediate asks (this week)
- Finexa: share sample of 500 anonymized utterances + test account for staging (Priya)
- Redwood: share sandbox access instructions and milestone sheet (attached)
- Agree kickoff date: propose Monday Nov 9 (US PST)

Attachments: proof-runway-milestones.xlsx (milestone sheet), sandbox-access-instructions.txt

If that matches your understanding we’ll pivot this to a mutual action plan and lock dates.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finexahealth.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya.desai@finexahealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 09:17:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Proof runway: onboarding cadence, roles & final readout plan

Thanks Sean — that looks good and very actionable. A couple of clarifications before we lock Nov 9: 

1) Data: We can provide 500 records but need a short checklist on anonymization we should run locally (PHI concerns). Priya — can you confirm?
2) Acceptance criteria: can you add an explicit pass/fail row for the readout (e.g., p50 latency <350ms, slot-extraction F1 >= 0.92, cost < $X per 1k)?
3) Sandbox: do you support mutual TLS for the staging endpoint? If not, we need a short-term plan for auth.

We prefer Nov 9 kickoff but can shift to Nov 10 if you need a day to finalize infra.

Alex
Director, Product
Finexa Health

Subject: Re: Proof runway: onboarding cadence, roles & final readout plan

Alex — great questions. Replying inline and attaching a success-metrics template (success-metrics-template.csv) to make the acceptance criteria concrete.

1) Data anonymization: We’ll attach a one-page checklist for common PHI elements to remove (names, SSNs, account numbers). Redwood engineers will only use a hashed patient-id for correlation. For extra assurance, we can accept a locally-scrubbed sample or connect to your staging via mTLS.

2) Acceptance criteria: added (see attachment) — suggested thresholds:
- p50 latency (512 tokens): < 350ms
- slot-extraction F1: >= 0.92 on seeded test set
- end-to-end success rate (business intent): >= 90%
- cost target: < $18 per 1k requests (estimate; final after optimization)

3) mTLS: We support mTLS for Private deployments. For hosted PoC we can provide a token-backed staging endpoint right away; if you need mutual TLS we’ll enable a temporary mTLS tunnel with Monica (SRE) owning the set-up. Monica is cc'd and can coordinate cert exchange.

Confirmed Nov 9 kickoff (Mon) — 9:30am PT. Agenda for week 0 kickoff live call attached in milestone sheet.

Next immediate items from Redwood (action owners):
- Sean: finalize mutual action plan and DocuSign SOW stub (today)
- Marissa: schedule weekly 30-min checkpoints (Mon/Wed) and invite list
- Monica: standby to provision mTLS or token endpoint; will confirm by EOD Thu

Alex/Priya — once we get the sanitized sample and confirm auth option we’ll move to sandbox access.

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Proof runway: onboarding cadence, roles & final readout plan

Alex/Priya — welcome aboard. Quick operational note from my side to ensure a smooth 5-week runway: 

Week-by-week owner checklist (short):
Week 0 (this week, onboarding)
- Finexa: upload sanitized sample to shared Drive folder (Alex)
- Redwood: create staging tenant + API keys; send onboarding README (Marissa)

Week 1 (baseline)
- Redwood: run baseline and surface p50/p95 latency + extraction F1 (Sean/Monica)
- Finexa: validate dataset mapping and provide feedback (Priya)

Week 2 (optimize)
- Redwood: iterate batching and quantization; report cost improvements (Monica)
- Finexa: run parallel integration smoke tests (Priya)

Week 3 (integration)
- Joint: run 5k request stress test and measure SLOs; collect logs for any failures (Monica + Finexa SRE)

Week 4 (finalize)
- Redwood: prepare readout pack and runbook (Marissa)
- Finexa: review for handoff and list outstanding questions (Alex)

Week 5 (readout)
- Joint: 45-min exec readout; final acceptance decision; next-step negotiation (commercial)

Logistics I’ll handle today:
- Calendar invites for weekly 30-min check-ins (Mon/Wed 9:30am PT) — invite sent
- Drive folder + milestone sheet shared (link in metadata)
- DocuSign SOW stub queued for review; Sean will push draft today

If this looks right I’ll mark the M.A.P. as draft and update as items clear. Small ask — please confirm who will attend the Week 5 readout (names/titles) so we can shape the exec summary.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success
Redwood Inference
